text:
nina: Quick sync 1: planning for the March webinar + accompanying benchmark report. Idea: tie the webinar CTA to a short credits + benchmark dashboard for attendees so we can measure activation lift.

rohit: Love it. What benchmark are we planning to show? latency and cost vs. common alternatives?

nina: Exactly. We'll highlight: median gen latency, tokens/sec on typical prompt, and cost per 1k tokens for our recommended config vs cloud baseline. Use a simple narrative 2x cheaper for streaming workloads

mea: We should avoid absolute claims unless we have reproducible test harness. Can we publish a short methodology appendix and link the eval scripts?

zac: Ops can run the harness. Suggest 3 workloads: chat assistant, summarization, and semantic search embeddings. We'll produce tables and 90th percentile latencies.

rohit: Webinar format = 25m demo + 15m Q&A + 5m quick teardown of the benchmark. Call-to-action: attendees get 200 free tokens + a pre-built prompt template pack. That should drive sample usage.

nina: Good. We need routing logic for inbound leads: anyone who redeems credits and calls >10 generations within 48h should be A-rated lead and forwarded to sales. Lower-intent go to nurture.

dave-sales: Agree. Put redemption + activity into the lead webhook with `source=webinar-benchmark-march` and `ref=attendee-id`. Also add `utm_campaign=webinar-benchmark-march`. I can prepare follow-up sequences for A and B leads.

mea: For the benchmark narrative copy: short headline, three bullets (what we measured, how, takeaway) and a CTA. I'll draft 2 variants: technical & business.

zac: Engineering checklist: 1) run harness on current infra, 2) freeze model config for report, 3) export reproducible logs, 4) expose a lightweight dashboard for attendees to view their own org's expected perf. Ops-bot: can you schedule runs?

ops-bot: Benchmark job scheduled: id=bench-2026-03-12, start=1771044000, expected finish=1771047600. Results will land in /reports/benchmarks/webinar-march.csv

rohit: Marketing assets: landing page, email invite, 30s social clips, in-console banner + modal for registered users. We should A/B test two CTAs: "Claim your tokens" vs "Run your benchmark".

nina: Good call. We'll track registrations -> redemption -> activation funnel. Primary metric = % attendees who redeem and call >5 gens in 72h. Secondary = meetings booked.

dave-sales: For routing, include `company_size` and `region` in payload so SDRs can triage. Also add `trial_status` (existing trial/customer) to avoid duplicates.

mea: Compliance note: make sure the promo doesn't conflict with existing offers. Exclude orgs with active partner promos or recent grants.

zac: Also, keep an eye on quota spikes after the webinar. Set a soft cap per org on auto-granted tokens and surface a message if they hit it.

nina: Timeline: draft benchmark + assets next week, engineering runs the harness Wed, landing page + registration open Thurs, webinar the following Tues.

rohit: I'll write the benchmark narrative and short methodology copy. Sharing draft by EOD Fri.

dave-sales: I'll prepare the follow-up playbook and SDR script with objection handling for cost/latency questions.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: ping #marketing 48h before webinar.

nina: Great work. Last ask: include a small microsurvey at the end of the webinar to capture use case and budget band. Helps segment leads.

rohit: Noted. Adding a 2-question survey in the Q&A flow.

zac: I'll post the initial benchmark CSV when available and tag you all.

nina: Thanks team 1 We'll reconvene early next week for final pre-launch.
